checks.name: secrets
checks.protects: Passwords, keys, and tokens written into any commit, including old ones.
checks.misses: Secrets in a shape the kit gitleaks settings do not know, and files git does not track.

checks.name: switch-offs
checks.protects: No comment in product code switches off a check, and no file that switches checks off is tracked anywhere.
checks.misses: Rules switched off in the settings files, and code outside productPaths or in notYetClean folders.

checks.name: ratchets
checks.protects: Counts in kit.ratchets.json (switch-offs, useEffect uses, flag groups) never go up.
checks.misses: Whether today's counted uses are right; it only stops new ones.

switchOffs.what: gitleaks:allow comment hides a line from the secret scan

switchOffFiles.name: oxlint-suppressions.json
switchOffFiles.what: oxlint-suppressions.json switches Oxlint rules off for whole files; delete it and fix the code

switchOffFiles.name: eslint-suppressions.json
switchOffFiles.what: eslint-suppressions.json switches ESLint rules off for whole files; delete it and fix the code

switchOffFiles.name: .gitleaksignore
switchOffFiles.what: .gitleaksignore hides found secrets from the secret scan; delete it, and remove and replace any real secret

switchOffFiles.name: .gitleaks.toml
switchOffFiles.what: .gitleaks.toml changes the secret scan settings so it can let secrets through; delete it (the kit settings in kit-lint/gitleaks.toml are used)
